I wonder what inspired such an increase?

Every time I learn of rape in my CJ class, I'm told that the definition of rape has been outdated for a long while. That definition was something about knowing carnal knowledge of a woman or something to that nature; basically excludes any rapes that did not occur vaginally or even rape against men. The new definition of rape as used by the FBI has only been a recent one, so of course numbers are now rising as what can be classified as a rape has broadened.

I wonder if a parallel situation is occurring in Europe or whether it really is "Statisticians say increase reflects greater willingness among victims to report attacks and better recording by the police".

Edit: Hmmm, nope. The cynical side of me was wrong this time, the history of the Rape in English Law shows that the definition has included penetration of "the vagina, anus or mouth of another person" as a definition rape since at least 2003 and had broadened the definition of rape to include males since 1994.
Its interesting to note that the article also makes a mention of a 11% decrease of crime in total. A good year, I suppose?

What would be the difference between them and AMORC. Do they have internal orders also?

From my understanding This order of Rosicrucians was founded by Paschal Beverly Randolph Hall in 1858 while AMORC was brought to America from France by Harvey Spencer Lewis in 1909. It also seems that The Fraternitas Rosae Crucis has a confederation of initiates with orders called the knights of chivalry and the order of the magi. These to my knowledge are not order within AMORC.

As far as I know these two groups of Rosicrucian are very different. The Fraternitas Rosae Crucis campus is located in my home state and is not more than 45 minutes from my home there is also a large pyramid on the grounds of the church of the illumination. However, in my estimation AMORC is quite public, they have a cultural outreach center in New York City, and a beautiful museum in San Jose, CA. While the Fraternitas is very private. Beyond that, I don't know very much else about specific degrees of those orders.
